_note: Speciality definitions for the ICB pack (scripts/build_icb_pack.py --speciality <id>). market = BNF presentation-code prefixes (NHSBSA English Prescribing Dataset). genericWords = first words of presentation names that are substances or formulations, not brands, so they fall into 'other'. rtt = NHS England Referral to Treatment treatment function, or null where none matches (it then reads Not applicable, never a substitute). Definitions are ours and are printed in the tool.

dermatology.label: Dermatology emollients
dermatology.marketText: BNF 130201 (emollient preparations) plus appliance section 2122 (emollients), primary care items

respiratory.label: Respiratory inhalers and oral treatments
respiratory.marketText: BNF 0301 (bronchodilators), 0302 (corticosteroids, including combination inhalers) and 0303 (leukotriene receptor antagonists and phosphodiesterase type 4 inhibitors), primary care items

diabetes.label: Diabetes medicines and testing
diabetes.marketText: BNF 0601 (drugs used in diabetes, including insulins, antidiabetic drugs and blood glucose testing), primary care items

wound-care.label: Wound care dressings
wound-care.marketText: BNF-code section 2003 (wound management and other dressings, appliance list), primary care items
